title: Sword SMP
description: This is the newest update of Sword, featuring custom maces
body:
This is a remake of the famous SWORD SMP,

Featuring the upgraded swords. Every kill you get you upgrade your current sword.

A lightweight SMP plugin where every player starts with a wooden sword and levels it up with every kill. Each kill upgrades your sword to the next tier, but beware: die 3 times while holding a wooden sword and you're deathbanned

Deathbans can happen if you die 3 times in the wooden sword stage, ( CAN be removed from config )
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47e68bf944ef1d1e8ff73bdd77595a0c84bb5817_0.webp)


Designed to be low-lag, stable, and bug-free, with a highly customizable config so you can tweak the progression exactly how you want.

Perfect for SMP servers looking to add simple but intense progression.
